post.description: Project-scoped upstream MCP registration. Preview rediscovers the live catalog with the saved endpoint, transport and credential, and reports how it differs from the certified catalog. It never invokes a tool and never changes the registration, its certification or any toolset.

200.description: Live catalog compared with the certified catalog

422.description: Registration cannot be reviewed or upstream certification failed

post.description: Project-scoped upstream MCP registration. Approval rediscovers the live catalog with the saved binding and certifies it as a new immutable revision only when the discovered protocol version and digest still match the reviewed preview and the registration still matches If-Match. It never invokes a tool.

409.description: Retired registration, catalog changed since review, or live catalog already certified

protocol_version.description: Protocol version discovered by the reviewed catalog preview.

digest.description: Catalog digest discovered by the reviewed catalog preview.

tools.description: Tool names this published toolset pins on this server.

toolsets.description: Visible published toolsets whose current revision pins any tool on this server. Approval creates a new server revision, so each one serves these tools again only after it is republished.

credential.description: Static upstream bearer material. Omission retains it; null removes it. Never returned or copied into tool metadata.

unit_price.description: Unit price for each dispatched tool call in the installation pricing currency, with no currency conversion. Null means unpriced, which refuses dispatch while an enforced budget ceiling applies. An explicit 0 is a known free price. The price is pinned by the certified server revision.

tool_prices.description: Per-tool unit prices keyed by certified tool name, in the installation pricing currency. A tool price overrides the server unit price for that tool.

calls_per_minute.description: Dispatched calls per minute allowed against this server across all keys. Defaults to 60 and stays inside installation limits.

max_concurrency.description: Concurrent dispatched calls allowed against this server across all keys. Defaults to 8 and stays inside installation limits.

per_key_calls_per_minute.description: Dispatched calls per minute allowed for one API key against this server. Defaults to 60 and stays inside installation limits.

per_key_max_concurrency.description: Concurrent dispatched calls allowed for one API key against this server. Defaults to 8 and stays inside installation limits.

delegation_private_key.description: PKCS8 Ed25519 private signing key. Omit to retain the existing local key.

entra_client_secret.description: Dedicated middle-tier client secret. Stored sealed and omitted from reads and exports.
